legacyText.title: Koh Talabeng Kayak & Koh Bubu | Secret Travel & Tour
intro: Koh Talabeng is a group of limestone islets off the east coast of Koh Lanta. You paddle around them by kayak. Koh Bubu is a small island nearby, reached by longtail, with a beach for the stop.
legacyText.cardDescription: Kayaking around the limestone islets of Koh Talabeng, then a beach stop on Koh Bubu.
goodToKnow: Tell us if you have never kayaked. The kayaks are two-seaters.
Give us the ages of children when you book. Full-day and half-day kayak trips to Koh Talabeng, with prices, are on the kayaking page.
